facts.fact: 工作间观察周：Dale 在店内 rearrange（give them more appeal）就安稳、回工作间「不一致也当没变」；Candace 混名（Zara 高中同学池）、model train set 循环问答（早卖了/cheapskates）。
facts.anchor: Zak relaxed back here because Dale was comfortable in the store and loved to busy himself with rearranging things to “give them more appeal.”

facts.fact: 谎报方针之争：火车模型早没了、母亲「在 estate sale」——Zara 反对、Zak 坚持（不 upsetting 他）；Kyle 装的第二道 chime 一响他就冲出去确认父亲没溜；店里就放父亲跑 patter。
facts.anchor: Zara hates that I lie and say Mom’s at an estate sale or whatever, but I don’t see the point in upsetting him.

facts.fact: 生意真相：hell no 不赚钱——楼上租+隔壁店租只够亮灯；「a day camp for Dad that we don't have to pay for」；boomers 凋零/millennials 不念旧、线上走 Roddie 拍照的网站——Zak 付出 top earning years+无人看见的 emotional toll。
facts.anchor: But we own the building. The rentals upstairs and the shop next door give us enough to keep the lights on.

facts.fact: 冲突爆发：她的 emotional support 担忧被拒——words landed like lawn darts in my chest；「You know you're not my only friend, right?」；她的 throwing rocks 指责被他修正：We're not ending——go fix your life。
facts.anchor: I’m not your son, Meg. You don’t have to solve my problems for me.

facts.fact: 全书第一次「我爱你」：先自审（像在留人）再交付——「keep texting stupid shit until you block me／九月回来帮你搬妈、fuck your brains out at least once／I'll be here when you get back」；她 lip quivering、同爱不敢说（说了就真会留下）；Georgia 肩上痛哭；告别短而痛、text 承诺半信半疑。
facts.anchor: I wasn’t going to say it because it sounds like I’m only saying it to keep you here, but I do. Now you know.
